root_idea.summary: A root orientation toward decisively securing, perfecting, and carrying a matter through to its proper end.
root_idea.development: From bringing a matter to completion and enforcing it arise the Quranic uses for completion, decree, judgment, decisive communication, and the fulfillment or termination of a term; related derivatives extend to judgeship, legal decisions, debt claims, and implication.

senses.definition: To complete, finish, or fully carry out a matter, act, term, or prescribed rite.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for bringing an undertaking, worship rite, appointed period, or affair to completion; the grammatical voice and tense vary across Quranic occurrences.

senses.definition: To decisively decree, ordain, or command a matter.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially used of a divine decree or command, including the decisive willing or ordering of a thing to be.

senses.definition: To bring something into completed existence, especially by a creative act.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic creative use presents the object as brought into an ordered, completed state.

senses.definition: To judge or decide a matter with final authority.
senses.usage_conditions: In judicial use, it can denote adjudicating a matter or deciding between or against parties.

senses.definition: To communicate or reveal a matter decisively, conveying it as an established decree.
senses.usage_conditions: With إِلَى in the Quranic construction قَضَيْنَا إِلَى, it denotes a decisively delivered notification or revelation.

senses.definition: To bring a life, appointed term, or matter to its end; in death-related usage, to die or cause death.
senses.usage_conditions: Death-related expressions include قَضَى نَحْبَهُ and قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتَ; قَضَى نَحْبَهُ is also explained as fulfilling a vowed commitment.

senses.definition: Decreed, ordained, or made inevitable; settled for fulfillment.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes a matter whose decree or appointed outcome has been decisively fixed.

senses.definition: One who judges or decisively decides; a judge.
senses.usage_conditions: The active participle is substantivized for a person exercising judgment or issuing a decision.

senses.definition: The decisive end; death or a final termination.
senses.usage_conditions: A lexicalized feminine active participle used for an ending from which there is no return.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain, obtain, or accomplish one's want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use with a person's need or desired outcome as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay, discharge, or satisfy a debt, due, claim, or demand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a debt or due that is fully rendered to its rightful recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay or render satisfaction for another person, on that person's behalf or in that person's stead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with عَنْهُ, also extended figuratively to rendering satisfaction for something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom, to induce or occasion extreme wonder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Restricted to the cited idiomatic expression rather than a general standalone meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cite or bring someone before a judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III usage describing referral of a person to judicial proceedings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive a debt from someone.
To pass away, come to an end or to nothing, or become cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VII use for the ending or disappearance of a thing or period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To require, entail, imply, or necessitate something as its consequence or concomitant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII use for what a matter necessarily involves or requires to be conceded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand one's due from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII use with a person's due as the object of the demand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive one's due from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII use for obtaining a due that is owed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demand payment or delivery of one's due or debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X causative/requesting use, especially with a debt or due.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In legal terminology, performance or make-up of an obligation, opposed to أَدَاء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal noun, especially for performing an obligation after its ordinary time or mode.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decree, ordinance, sentence, or judicial decision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal usage for an authoritative determination or judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exercise of the office of a judge, or judgeship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical institutional sense referring to judicial office and its exercise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing, affair, matter, case, event, or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general usage; it is also used as a synonym of أَمْر or شَأْن, though its classical lexical status is limited in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A universal or general prescript, rule, or canon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical usage for a general proposition or rule applying universally.
Technical logical usage concerning a statement that can be evaluated as true or false.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exigence, requirement, or implication; that which an expression indicates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for what a matter or wording necessitates or entails.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Completion by word or deed, including command and creative completion.
Divine willing that necessitates a thing's being.
Quranic construction for decisively willing a matter to be.
Decreeing and judicial deciding are covered by the form's decree and judgment senses.
Discharging a debt, due, claim, or demand.
Fully giving or paying another's due.
Rendering satisfaction for another or in another's stead.
Finishing prayer, pilgrimage, or its rites.
Lexical idiom meaning to induce wonder.
Form VI receipt of a debt.
Demanding payment of a due or debt.
Technical legal term opposed to أداء.
Nominal decree, sentence, or judicial decision.
General matter, affair, case, event, or action.

cautions: The Form I Quran group combines active and passive forms and several constructions; translation depends on the object and construction, not merely on the root.
قَضَى نَحْبَهُ is explained both as fulfilling a self-imposed vow and as dying; the death-related sense is therefore retained with that interpretive nuance.
Lane's historical bracketed Quran citations are not used here as modern verse locations unless the location is independently supplied by QAC.
